<h2 id="h_2079327452615160431_0" data-first-child="" data-into-catalog-status="">一 简介</h2>
<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_1" data-into-catalog-status="">1.1 AScript</h3>
<p data-pid="l70OT3Xn">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持自定义语法，支持扩展多种脚本语言（目前已支持C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua五种语言），支持解释执行和编译执行两种执行模式，并且支持编译缓存。</p>
<p data-pid="lAOtJj0J">目前官方最新版本：1.7.2</p>
<p data-pid="eAec5rsR">开源地址：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
<li data-pid="eAec5rsR"><a title="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" href="https://github.com/rockey627/AScript" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/rockey627/AScript</a></li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="v4GoY2bd">相关文章：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="3sZvkwaC"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22579720" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">C#脚本引擎之AScript与Flee对比</a></li>
<li data-pid="mJAjX8_4"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22627381" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">C#脚本引擎之AScript与DynamicExpresso对比</a></li>
<li data-pid="BVY0dqbo"><a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22706798" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">C#脚本引擎之AScript与Jurassic、Jint对比</a></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_2" data-into-catalog-status="">1.2 Z.Expressions.Eval</h3>
<p data-pid="RuOxliRT">Z.Expression.Eval是一个非常强大的工具，使得开发人员可以动态编译和执行C#代码和表达式。</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="Byl_utpP">Execute C# Code</li>
<li data-pid="bNp7kcJX">Compile C# Code</li>
<li data-pid="skXxjkJ7">LINQ&nbsp;Dynamic</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="J2231kbE">目前官方最新版本：6.3.13</p>
<p data-pid="UFwEU18s">官网地址：<a class=" wrap external" href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//eval-expression.net/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-draft-type="text-link" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">https://eval-expression.net</a></p>
<h2 id="h_2079327452615160431_3" data-into-catalog-status="">二 功能</h2>
<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_4" data-into-catalog-status="">2.1 编译缓存</h3>
<p data-pid="OgWy0lgB">二者皆支持编译缓存功能：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AScript默认不启用缓存</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Z.Expressions.Eval默认启用缓存</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Z.Expressions.EvalManager.DefaultContext.UseCache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = Z.Expressions.Eval.Execute&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">5 + 6</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>同时AScript支持缓存版本控制和定时清理缓存功能：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算表达式，返回结果
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="expression"&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">脚本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheTime"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">缓存时长</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">为0表示不使用缓存（默认）；</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">-1表示永久缓存；</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;para&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">大于0表示缓存时长（单位：毫秒）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/para&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheKey"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缓存key（如果为空则取表达式字符串）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;param name="cacheVersion"&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 缓存版本号，如果版本号有变化，则重新编译并缓存
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/param&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> expression, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(Stream expression, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; expression, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(Func&lt;Stream&gt; expression, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> EvalFile(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> path, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> cacheTime = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="2LHlFg3h"><strong><em>场景一</em></strong></p>
<p data-pid="VOlurOkx">脚本保存在数据库或其他远程端，以业务标识为cacheKey，以修改时间戳为cacheVersion：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheKey = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xxx</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">当前版本</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval(()=&gt;获取脚本, cacheTime: -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, cacheKey, cacheVersion);</pre>
</div>
<p>如果版本未变化，则直接执行缓存中的委托；<br>如果版本有变化，则重新获取脚本--&gt;编译--&gt;缓存--&gt;执行。</p>
<p data-pid="uwXfI5mr"><strong><em>场景二</em></strong></p>
<p data-pid="bK8RrUw8">脚本保存在文件中，可以调用EvalFile方法，默认cacheKey为文件完整路径，cacheVersion可以设置为修改时间：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> cacheVersion =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.IO.File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(path).Ticks.ToString();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.EvalFile(path, cacheTime: -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, cacheVersion: cacheVersion);</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="r4ydv7Tk">如果文件未修改，则直接执行缓存中的委托；<br>如果文件有修改，则重新读取文件--&gt;编译--&gt;缓存--&gt;执行。</p>
<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_5" data-into-catalog-status="">2.2 Compile</h3>
<p data-pid="EROqKgB9">将脚本编译生成委托：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AScript</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; func = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a + 5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; func = script.Compile&lt;Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a + 5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>[] { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Z.Expressions.Eval</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt; func = Z.Expressions.Eval.Compile&lt;Func&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a + 5</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_6" data-into-catalog-status="">2.3 注入函数</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="iPc4J2V-">添加类中的方法</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> AScript</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加静态方法，支持扩展方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> script.Context.AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(MyClass));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加实例方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> script.Context.AddFunc(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyClass());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sum(5, 6)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello('tom')</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Z.Expressions.Eval：支持静态方法，不支持实例方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> Z.Expressions.EvalManager.DefaultContext.RegisterStaticMethod(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(MyClass));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Z.Expressions.Eval.Execute(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sum(5, 6)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyClass
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Sum(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> a, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> b) =&gt; a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Hello(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> name) =&gt; $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello {name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_7" data-into-catalog-status="">2.4 递归函数</h3>
<p data-pid="dRaNzrp5">AScript支持定义递归函数，Z.Expressions.Eval不支持递归函数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int fib(int n) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    if (n &lt;= 1) return n;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fib(10)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(code); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 55</span></pre>
</div>
<p>相关文章：<a class="internal" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/22831561" data-draft-type="text-link" data-icon-name="zhicon_icon_24_paper_plain_text" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">AScript之编译递归函数</a></p>

<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_10" data-into-catalog-status="">2.7 LINQ查询语法</h3>
<p data-pid="zMNXd6D9">AScript支持查询语法，Z.Expressions.Eval不支持。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> code = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var list = new List&lt;int&gt;() { 1, 2, 3, 4 };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = from item in list
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    where item &gt; 2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    select item * 10;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">return q.ToList();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = script.Eval&lt;List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;&gt;(code);</pre>
</div>

<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_12" data-into-catalog-status="">2.9 层级上下文</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="AhgAqcOq">Z.Expressions.Eval中的EvalContext不支持层级，创建EvalContext实例成本高</li>

</ul>

<h3 id="h_2079327452615160431_14" data-into-catalog-status="">3.1 常量表达式</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">100 * (5 + 5) * (6-2)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> r = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>) * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>

<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://pica.zhimg.com/80/v2-6bac097f0fb37e3d5e753cf3b7ba97da_1440w.webp" width="1755" height="225" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazy" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1755" data-rawheight="225" data-original-token="v2-6bac097f0fb37e3d5e753cf3b7ba97da" data-original="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-6bac097f0fb37e3d5e753cf3b7ba97da_r.jpg" data-actualsrc="https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-6bac097f0fb37e3d5e753cf3b7ba97da_1440w.jpg" data-lazy-status="ok"></div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="oFPOAdV9">AScript解释执行大循环语句性能较低，编译循环语句性能有提升；</li>
<li data-pid="WPb7KSfy">编译执行模式，二者性能相差不大</li>
</ul>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span>     Z.Expressions.EvalManager.DefaultContext.UseCache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = _list.WhereDynamic(a =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a % 2 == 0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Count();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (result != r) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Exception(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result error</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[Benchmark]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Enumerable_ZExpressions_Cache()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span>     Z.Expressions.EvalManager.DefaultContext.UseCache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">51</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = _list.WhereDynamic(a =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a % 2 == 0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Count();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">53</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="f53MCkka">测试结果：</p>
<div class="RichText-ConditionalImagePortal"><img src="https://picx.zhimg.com/80/v2-8786c8de57a79667b2f47e24aca1afc9_1440w.webp" width="1770" height="225" class="origin_image zh-lightbox-thumb lazy" data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1770" data-rawheight="225" data-original-token="v2-8786c8de57a79667b2f47e24aca1afc9" data-original="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-8786c8de57a79667b2f47e24aca1afc9_r.jpg" data-actualsrc="https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-8786c8de57a79667b2f47e24aca1afc9_1440w.jpg" data-lazy-status="ok"></div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="YarLxR18">性能：AScript &gt; Z.Expressions.Eval</li>
<li data-pid="W3iPgSvc">IEnumerable扩展方法，Z.Expressions.Eval开启缓存时性能高，因为少了编译操作</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="h_2079327452615160431_23" data-into-catalog-status="">四 总结</h2>
<table data-draft-node="block" data-draft-type="table" data-size="normal" data-row-style="normal">
<tbody>
<tr><th>功能</th><th>AScript</th><th>Z.Expressions.Eval</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>.NET框架</td>
<td>net45<br>netstandard2.0<br>netstandard2.1<br>net6.0<br>net8.0</td>
<td>net40<br>net45<br>netstandard2.0<br>netstandard2.1<br>net6.0<br>net8.0<br>net10.0</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>开源</td>
<td>免费MIT开源</td>
<td>收费</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>性能</td>
<td>高</td>
<td>高</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>内存占用</td>
<td>低</td>
<td>中</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>执行模式</td>
<td>解释执行+编译执行+编译缓存</td>
<td>编译执行+编译缓存</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>缓存版本控制</td>
<td>支持</td>
<td>不支持</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>Lambda</td>
<td>支持</td>
<td>支持</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>LINQ查询语法</td>
<td>支持</td>
<td>不支持</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>递归函数</td>
<td>支持</td>
<td>不支持</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>自定义语法</td>
<td>支持</td>
<td>不支持</td>

</tr>

</tbody>

</table>
<ul>
<li data-pid="8llJl4WR">执行小体量脚本时，AScript的解释执行模式性能较高，适合执行碎片化临时脚本的场景；</li>
<li data-pid="0BrulwXj">编译执行模式，两者性能相差不大，适合执行临时、大体量、大循环脚本的场景；</li>
<li data-pid="gZ0BhEmf">编译缓存模式，AScript性能比Z.Expressions.Eval高，适合执行高频、脚本固定或变化少的场景；</li>
<li data-pid="9jEjXflX">AScript扩展能力强，支持多种脚本语言。</li>

</ul>
<p data-pid="0FVb-NRz">综上，AScript脚本引擎优势还是比较明显的。</p>
